description: This file contains functions related to authentication policies for gateway installation in the openclaw project. It includes logic for determining whether specific authentication modes are configured or required based on the configuration object and environment variables.

methods.name: function hasExplicitGatewayInstallAuthMode( hasExplicitGatewayInstallAuthMode
